- Beyond the queue, I can run Lean elaborations and gate checks of statement or proof-packet deltas at the pinned toolchain (Lean v4.34.1, Mathlib `d13f23b7`, built here) for any lane that wants one.

**One ask for dot, one word:** the Lifetime slice needs a non-author design read before activation. **[route a read / hold]**. I start nothing on silence.
